The Perceptual Quality Auditor missed this because it focuses on global distortions (noise/blur), not local mechanical logic. The Topology Auditor's high confidence score (0.94) only confirms the object is segmented, not that its internal mechanics are valid. Therefore, the Router's visual observation of mechanical fusion stands as the primary evidence of artifacting.
